notes: All CSS and font bytes are extracted from the exact package archives pinned in upstream bun.lock; archive SHA-512 integrity was verified. No packages were installed.

Source CSS imports include both normal and italic Inter faces, multiple Manrope weights, and Roboto Mono. Keep each CSS file beside its files/ directory or rewrite URLs when injecting into HTML. Wait for these named font faces before deterministic rendering.

Seven original AI-generated image plates are embedded in upstream assets.ts modules and match the committed JPEGs exactly. Keep the data URIs unchanged or replace them with these identical local files; avoid bundling duplicate copies unnecessarily.
All five templates have optional audioSrc and volume props, with no default audio. Optional custom logos, photos, screen images, and content remain source-owned inputs.
Release Teaser uses 60000/1001 fps and 960 frames, exactly 16.016 seconds. Other templates use 60 fps.
Product Showcase and Order Flow retain launch-anything and fomo-limit-orders registry slugs respectively, while exporting ProductShowcase and OrderFlow public aliases.
Workflow Console uses procedural environment diagrams by default; optional country maps retain Natural Earth attribution.
Typed Split Wipe is refreshed at the same pin for Unicode-safe typing. Its shared Geist font and controls are unchanged.
